svg.title: Recipe domain: card family, Browse toolbar and RecipeDetailSheet (Era 3)
svg.desc: Layer 3B Recipe domain board for WFS Family Cookbook Era 3.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3
One recipe speaks the same visual language on Home, Browse stack/grid, Discovery voting, and Detail sheet.
Part 1 · Unified Recipe Card Family across 4 contexts
Card body header holds Ready in blush pill (white surface)
QuickFind adds inline View details ▾ · Select CTA stays reachable
Photo holds solid bg-cream Ready in; inline details replaces 3D flip
Warm tortillas, spiced beef and colourful peppers ready for
everyone to assemble at the table (line-clamp-2 if non-empty).
Adds concise line-clamp-2 description; zero cuisine/meal-type clutter
Opaque white 1px border card · 4:3 photo + 12px sentence Ready in
Part 2 · Recipes Browse toolbar & planning banner
Search input + Filters expand progressively below trigger
Primary when confirmed planned; neutral white otherwise
View Original sits at hero bottom-right on bg-cream/80 translucent capsule (never obscures title; keyboard-focusable outline-charcoal).
Original quantities live under ••• progressive menu.
Slice onions & peppers; brown beef over medium.
Simmer with seasoning and assemble tortillas.
Scaled notice appears quietly when factor != 1 without hiding steps.
Locked Household Order: 1 Rating → 2 Notes (directly writable) → 3 Ask the Family
Directly writable field (no wrapping card/duplicate title);
unconfirmed edits keep draft + inline Retry save.
Shows in Discovery voting (switch uses garden-fill)
Occupied supper disposition · Replace Take Out confirmation · Unconfirmed reply → Retry check / Review plan.
Bottom Planning Dock (scrollable max-h-[45dvh], safe-area bottom padding)
Phone (< 768px): full-screen sheet; Tablet (>= 768px): max-w-5xl rounded dialog.
